title: The Three Demon Lords
summary: Arriving at the foothills of Mount Obsidian, Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun gaze upon the grand gates of the Fallen Throne. The Three Demon Lords mobilize their planetary demonic armadas for total war as Arc 5 concludes.

panels.shot: mount obsidian grand establishing wide shot
panels.action: A titanic 15,000-foot volcanic peak of black obsidian crystal towering above the Abyssal clouds.
panels.prose_en: A titanic 15,000-foot volcanic peak of black obsidian crystal towering above the Abyssal clouds.
panels.prose_hi: Kale obsidian crystal ka ek titanic 15,000 foot ka jwalamukhi shikhar, jo abisal baadalon ke upar uncha hai.

panels.shot: floating crystalline staircases wrapping around the mountain
panels.action: Ten thousand floating stone steps spiral up the sheer cliffs toward the cloud-piercing summit.
panels.prose_en: Ten thousand floating stone steps spiral up the sheer cliffs toward the cloud-piercing summit.
panels.prose_hi: Das hajar tairti hui patthar ki sidhiyan khadi chattanon se baadalon ko bhedne wale shikhar ki or badhti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun landing at the stairway base
panels.action: Ha-Jun glides to a smooth landing on the first massive obsidian step, folding his shadow wings.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun glides to a smooth landing on the first massive obsidian step, folding his shadow wings.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne chhaya pankhon ko modate hue, pehle vishal obsidian kadam par aasani se utarne ke liye glide karta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping down with renewed strength
panels.action: Tae-Jun's color is fully restored, standing tall in dark traveling cloaks beside Ha-Jun.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Yeh steps... Sirf wahi chad sakta hai jiske paas Kam se kam 6 Relics hon.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's color is fully restored, standing tall in dark traveling cloaks beside Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ka rang puri tarah se bahaal ho gaya hai, wah ha-jun ke bagal mein gahre yatra wale labadon mein lamba khada hai.

panels.shot: relic pressure barrier at the base of the steps
panels.action: A glowing violet gravitational pressure barrier tests the travelers' lineage.
panels.prose_en: A glowing violet gravitational pressure barrier tests the travelers' lineage.
panels.prose_hi: Ek chamakta hua baingani gurutvakarshan dabav avrodhak yatriyon ki vanshavali ka parikshan karta hai.

panels.shot: all six relics on ha-jun body resonating simultaneously
panels.action: Feather, Ring, Bone, Heart, Fang, and Chains ignite in unison; the barrier parts like curtains of light.

dialogue.text:
[BARRIER RECOGNITION CONFIRMED]
Identity: TRUE SOVEREIGN SUCCESSOR
Lineage Purity: 99.8%
Access to Mount Obsidian: UNRESTRICTED

panels.prose_en: Feather, Ring, Bone, Heart, Fang, and Chains ignite in unison; the barrier parts like curtains of light.
panels.prose_hi: Pankh, anguthi, haddi, hridy, dant aur janjeeren ek swar mein prajvalit hoti han; avrodhak bhag prakash ke pardon ke samaan han.

panels.shot: kuro looking up the steps with deep emotion
panels.action: Kuro wipes a lone tear from his eye: 'Hazaaron saal ho gaye... Maine yeh gates khulte nahi dekhe the.'
panels.prose_en: Kuro wipes a lone tear from his eye: 'Hazaaron saal ho gaye... Maine yeh gates khulte nahi dekhe the.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apni aankh se ek akela aansu ponchta hai: 'hajaron saal ho gaye... maine yeh gate khulte nahin dekhe the.'

panels.shot: ha-jun placing hand on kuro head gently
panels.action: Ha-Jun gently strokes Kuro's feathered head: 'Tumhare bina main yahan tak kabhi nahi pahunch pata, Kuro.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Thank you for never giving up on me.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun gently strokes Kuro's feathered head: 'Tumhare bina main yahan tak kabhi nahi pahunch pata, Kuro.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun dheere se kuro ke pankh wale sir par haath ferta hai: 'tumhare bina main yahan tak ​​kabhi nahin pahunch pata, kuro.'

panels.shot: kuro blushing through feathers
panels.action: Kuro huffs playfully: 'D-Don't get sentimental! We still have a Crown to claim!'
panels.prose_en: Kuro huffs playfully: 'D-Don't get sentimental! We still have a Crown to claim!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro chanchalta se chillata hai: 'd-bhawook mat bano! hamare paas abhi bhi dawa karne ke liye ek taj hai!'

panels.shot: far away in the iron citadel: demon lord malgath mobilizing
panels.action: Demon Lord Malgath dons his colossal 20-foot spiked armor, raising an iron war banner.

dialogue.speaker: malgath
dialogue.text: ASSEMBLE THE JUGGERNAUTS! WE MARCH ON MOUNT OBSIDIAN!

panels.prose_en: Demon Lord Malgath dons his colossal 20-foot spiked armor, raising an iron war banner.
panels.prose_hi: Danav lord malgath ne apna vishal 20 foot ka nukila kavach pahan rakha hai aur lohe ka yudh dhvaj lahra raha hai.

panels.shot: hundreds of thousands of iron demon soldiers marching
panels.action: A terrifying army of 300,000 armored demon soldiers marching across the burning plains with siege towers.
panels.prose_en: A terrifying army of 300,000 armored demon soldiers marching across the burning plains with siege towers.
panels.prose_hi: 300,000 bakhtarband rakshas sainikon ki ek bhayanak sena gherabandi toweron ke saath jalte maidanon mein march kar rahi hai.

panels.shot: in the shadow abyss: demon lord valac commanding assassins
panels.action: Lord Valac weaves a colossal dark eclipse spell, cloaking 100,000 shadow wraiths in invisibility.
panels.prose_en: Lord Valac weaves a colossal dark eclipse spell, cloaking 100,000 shadow wraiths in invisibility.
panels.prose_hi: Lord valack ek vishal andhere grahan ka jadu bunata hai, jisse 100,000 chhaya ke aavaran adrishya ho jaate han.

panels.shot: in the void palace: queen lilith opening abyssal rifts
panels.action: Queen Lilith tears open fifty dimensional portals toward Earth and Mount Obsidian simultaneously.
panels.prose_en: Queen Lilith tears open fifty dimensional portals toward Earth and Mount Obsidian simultaneously.
panels.prose_hi: Rani lilith ek saath prithvi aur mount obsidian ki or pachas aayami portal kholti hai.

panels.shot: the entire demon realm shaking with impending clash
panels.action: The sky turns pitch-black as three million demonic soldiers converge on Mount Obsidian from three directions.

dialogue.text: Abyss ke itihaas ki sabse badi jung shuru hone wali thi.

panels.prose_en: The sky turns pitch-black as three million demonic soldiers converge on Mount Obsidian from three directions.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi teen million rakshasi sainik teen dishaon se mount obsidian par ekatrit hote han, aakash ekdum kala ho jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking down from the 1,000th step
panels.action: From high on the staircase, Ha-Jun watches the three colossal armies marching across the horizon.
panels.prose_en: From high on the staircase, Ha-Jun watches the three colossal armies marching across the horizon.
panels.prose_hi: Sidhiyon par upar se, ha-jun teen vishal senaon ko kshitij ke paar march karte hue dekhta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun standing beside him with unyielding eyes
panels.action: Tae-Jun crosses his arms: 'Woh teenon aa rahe hain, Ha-Jun. Poori army ke saath.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Lekin jab tak tumhare paas Crown hoga... Unki army tumhare saamne ghutne tekegi.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun crosses his arms: 'Woh teenon aa rahe hain, Ha-Jun. Poori army ke saath.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ne apni bahen paar kin: 'vo teenan aa rahe han, ha-jun. puri sena ke sath.'

panels.shot: ha-jun turning his back on the armies to ascend
panels.action: Ha-Jun turns toward the summit without a single drop of fear: 'Toh chaliye pehle Crown le aate hain.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun turns toward the summit without a single drop of fear: 'Toh chaliye pehle Crown le aate hain.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun bina kisi dar ke shikhar ki or mudta hai: 'to chaliye pehle crown le aate han.'

panels.shot: ascending through the cloud layer into golden light
panels.action: The brothers break through the violet cloud layer, stepping into blinding golden celestial light.
panels.prose_en: The brothers break through the violet cloud layer, stepping into blinding golden celestial light.
panels.prose_hi: Bhai baingani badal ki parat ko todte hue, chakachaundh kar dene wali sunhari akashiya roshni mein kadam rakhte han.

panels.shot: the summit plateau of the fallen throne reveal
panels.action: An immense circular plateau of pure white diamond marble, surrounded by twelve shattered stone thrones.
panels.prose_en: An immense circular plateau of pure white diamond marble, surrounded by twelve shattered stone thrones.
panels.prose_hi: Shuddh safed heere sangmarmar ka ek vishal golakar pathar, jo barah toote hue patthar ke sinhasanon se ghira hua hai.

panels.shot: the colossal central throne of the first demon sovereign
panels.action: In the center towers a 40-foot throne carved from solid midnight star-matter, glowing with eternal violet flame.
panels.prose_en: In the center towers a 40-foot throne carved from solid midnight star-matter, glowing with eternal violet flame.
panels.prose_hi: Kendra mein ek 40 foot ka sinhasan hai jo thos madhyaratri taara-padarth se bana hai, jo shashwat baingani lau se chamak raha hai.

panels.shot: floating above the throne: the crown of the sovereign
panels.action: Suspended above the throne seat: an ornate gothic crown of obsidian and blood-ruby, radiating absolute monarch aura.

dialogue.text:
[TARGET LOCATED: CROWN OF THE SOVEREIGN (LEGENDARY RELIC)]
Authority: Sovereign Domain & Monarch Subjugation
Requirement: Absolute Mental Fortitude.

panels.prose_en: Suspended above the throne seat: an ornate gothic crown of obsidian and blood-ruby, radiating absolute monarch aura.
panels.prose_hi: Sinhasan ki seat ke upar nilambit: obsidian aur rakt-manik ka ek alankrit gothic mukut, jo purna samrat aabha bikherta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun walking slowly toward the throne steps
panels.action: Ha-Jun approaches the foot of the throne; his footsteps ring like cathedral chimes across the marble.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun approaches the foot of the throne; his footsteps ring like cathedral chimes across the marble.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun sinhasan ke neeche pahunchta hai; uske kadmon ki aahat sangmarmar ke paar girjaghar ki jhankar ki tarah bajti hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun and kuro watching with bated breath
panels.action: Tae-Jun and Kuro stop at the edge, watching the historical coronation with sacred silence.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun and Kuro stop at the edge, watching the historical coronation with sacred silence.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun aur kuro kinare par rukte hain aur pavitra maun ke saath aitihasik rajyabhishek dekhte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun ascending the seven steps to the throne
panels.action: One step at a time, Ha-Jun ascends: 1, 2, 3... 7.
panels.prose_en: One step at a time, Ha-Jun ascends: 1, 2, 3... 7.
panels.prose_hi: Ek samay mein ek kadam, ha-jun chadhta hai: 1, 2, 3... 7.

panels.shot: standing directly before the levitating crown
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands face-to-face with the crown; his reflection in the central ruby shows the First Sovereign's silhouette.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands face-to-face with the crown; his reflection in the central ruby shows the First Sovereign's silhouette.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun taj ke saath aamne-samne khada hai; kendriya manik mein unka pratibimb pratham samprabhu ke silhut ko darshata hai.

panels.shot: ancient deep voice resonating from inside the crown
panels.action: A thunderous primordial voice echoes in Ha-Jun's soul: 'WHO DARES CLAIM THE CROWN OF ASMODAIUS?!'

dialogue.speaker: first_sovereign_voice
dialogue.text: KAUN HAI WOH JO MERE THRONE PAR BAITHNA CHAHTA HAI?!

panels.prose_en: A thunderous primordial voice echoes in Ha-Jun's soul: 'WHO DARES CLAIM THE CROWN OF ASMODAIUS?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki aatma mein ek gadgdati maulik awaz goonjati hai: 'asamodice ke taj par dawa karne ki himmat kaun karta hai?!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking the voice dead in the eye
panels.action: Ha-Jun raises both hands toward the crown, his voice steady as eternity: 'Main Ha-Jun Kang hoon.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main tumhara puppet nahi... Main is bloodline ka naya aur aakhri Sovereign hoon!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun raises both hands toward the crown, his voice steady as eternity: 'Main Ha-Jun Kang hoon.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun donon haath mukut ki or uthata hai, uski awaz anant kaal ki tarah sthir hai: 'main ha-jun kang hun.'

panels.shot: ha-jun lowering the crown onto his head
panels.action: Ha-Jun places the obsidian-and-ruby Crown of the Sovereign firmly onto his brow.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun places the obsidian-and-ruby Crown of the Sovereign firmly onto his brow.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun sovereign ke obseedian-aur-rubi crown ko majbuti se apni bhaunh par rakhta hai.

panels.shot: blinding pillar of golden-violet light erupting to the heavens
panels.action: A ten-mile-wide pillar of golden-violet celestial mana erupts from the summit, tearing through the cosmos.
panels.prose_en: A ten-mile-wide pillar of golden-violet celestial mana erupts from the summit, tearing through the cosmos.
panels.prose_hi: Sunahre-bangni akashiya man ka das meal chauda stambh brahmand ko chirate hue shikhar se futata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun sitting upon the throne with glowing eyes and crown
panels.action: Sitting tall upon the Sovereign's Throne, crowned in obsidian ruby, eyes burning with absolute rule: Arc 5 concluded.

dialogue.text: The Demon Sovereign has taken his throne.

panels.prose_en: Sitting tall upon the Sovereign's Throne, crowned in obsidian ruby, eyes burning with absolute rule: Arc 5 concluded.
panels.prose_hi: Samprabhu ke sinhasan par uncha baitha hua, obsidian manik se susajjit, purna niyam se jalti hui aankhen: arc 5 ka samapan hua.
